title: Artist of the Week: Roman Flügel
content:
This week, our Artist of the Week comes from Germany, would you believe it, in the form of Roman Flügel. Flügel is one of the biggest names on the German electronic music scene, having been twiddling the knobs since the early 1990s, and has produced tracks in styles ranging from ambient to techno.

A few weeks ago, our Resident DJ Colpey Calling picked out a Flügel track in Something for the Weekend, so we decided to delve a little deeper and found this lovely little dancey number he produced in collaboration with Simian Mobile Disco.

Conal Dougan
